profile.name: Ndivhuwo Makhavhu
profile.tagline: Turning complex data into clear, actionable insights.
about: I am a data analyst based in Sandton, South Africa, working across financial markets and lead analytics.

I turn raw, fragmented data into clear and actionable insight. My work covers the full path from data to decision: sourcing and preparing the data, carrying out the analysis, and delivering the result as dashboards and data solutions that teams can act on. The objective is always business value — sharper priorities, stronger conversion, and decisions supported by evidence.

My background in web development means I do not stop at the analysis. I build the dashboards and tools that put insight in front of the people who need it. I am currently focused on applying AI within these data solutions to improve the speed and accuracy with which insight reaches the business.

projects.title: SME Rise Capital Matching
projects.summary: Data-driven capital matching model for SMEs.
projects.description: Developed a comprehensive model to analyze SME financial data and pair them with appropriate capital providers. Provided Recommedations on strategies on to optimize conversion rate on SME reciving capital funding.
